description: Pixel 9a uses Google’s most powerful chip yet, Tensor G4 – just like Pixel 9 and Pixel 9 Pro. It’s built for our most capable AI like Gemini and cutting-edge photos and videos. The 16.002 cm (6.3) Actua display is sharp, vibrant, and 35% brighter. It runs fast, up to 120 Hz, for smooth gaming, scrolling, and switching between apps. Pixel 9a is designed to handle spills, dust, drops, and dings. From IP68 water and dust protection to a scratch-resistant display and long-lasting materials, it’s the most durable Pixel A-Series phone yet. The Adaptive Battery on Pixel 9a can last over 30 hours. Need even more? Turn on Extreme Battery Saver to make it last up to 100. That’s big energy. Save time by asking Gemini to find information and get things done for you across your Google apps – like Maps, Calendar, Gmail, and YouTube Music. It’s multitasking made easy. Night Sight takes sharp, vivid photos, portraits, and panos in low light, like concerts and cityscapes – even the Milky Way with astrophotography.
